critical_code_review_comments: Lender images use lazy loading; on initial render up to ~10 images have naturalWidth=0 momentarily. Not a bug but consider loading='eager' for above-the-fold lender logos to prevent brief blank frames during marquee scroll.

PlatformDiagram nodes animate continuously (orbit) — automation tools cannot reliably hover them (Playwright element-not-stable). Consider pausing animation on hover-intent (parent group) so tooltip is stable; also useful for accessibility.
